major_concerns: The Technical Expert's claim regarding async describe race conditions (T-C1) is refuted by empirical evidence and Vitest 4 semantics; the architecture remains sound.

Test helper construction duplication (create-test-prisma.ts, test-db.ts) bypassing createPrismaClient() is a deliberate design boundary for Stage B migration (DD-003/DD-010), not a defect. The timeout constant dedup in eb707f9 resolves the maintainability concern.
minor_concerns: Hardcoded credential fallback in tests/helpers/create-test-prisma.ts:5-9 is pre-existing and slated for removal in Stage B via PGlite isolation; tracked as hygiene issue.
Shared test DB parallelism introduces residual flake risk until Stage B lands; mitigated by documented triage protocol in AGENTS.md and file-scoped fixture fixes in this changeset.
experts.summary: The Round-2 response commit eb707f9 successfully addresses all architectural concerns, particularly the timeout constant deduplication and clarification of test helper boundaries. The facade switch maintains strict dependency direction (src -> prisma-client/prisma-factory) and correct DI seams. The remaining minor issues are explicitly scoped to Stage B remediation with clear documentation, ensuring long-term maintainability without blocking current execution.

major_concerns: Shared single PostgreSQL DB with fileParallelism: true remains a bounded residual risk to the coverage gate (F-M2). The two known collisions are patched (file-unique userIds in tests/batch-import.test.ts; 'Phone-' relational scoping in tests/interview-plan-members-phone.test.ts:88-96) and the triage protocol is now documented at AGENTS.md:84, but nothing structurally prevents the next collision until Stage B PGlite (DD-005) lands. I require Stage B to land in-sprint as committed; the interim protocol is acceptable only as a bridge.

Test-helper construction duplication: tests/helpers/create-test-prisma.ts:1 and tests/helpers/test-db.ts:17 both construct PrismaPg adapters directly, bypassing createPrismaClient(). The author's scoping argument (prisma-factory.ts:8 'sole production construction point'; DD-003 line 146) is sound and Stage B replaces helper internals with PGlite, so this is a deliberate boundary — but the duplication is a real maintainability cost that must not silently persist past Stage B.
minor_concerns: Hardcoded credential fallback 'postgresql://investigator:zhulaoda@localhost:5432/dialog_survey_test' at tests/helpers/create-test-prisma.ts:5-9 (and pre-existing at test-db.ts:14). Pre-existing parity with origin/master and removed in Stage B, but the credential is in git history and the fallback silently dials localhost with a 5s timeout when env is unset. Track on the Stage B checklist.

getDb() (src/utils/db.ts) bypasses the DI seam and calls createPrismaClient() directly. Verified caught at src/core/graph.ts:66-71 and tests/graph.test.ts stubs DATABASE_URL, so no unhandled rejection — but the doomed-connection cost (~5s) materializes in Postgres-less runs. Accepted as non-blocking; revisit if Stage B makes getDb() mockable in this path.

tests/graph.test.ts intentionally keeps a process-lifetime vi.stubEnv without afterAll unstub. The author's empirical evidence (pending setImmediate outlives the last test; unstub re-surfaces an unhandled error) is credible and the file comment at tests/graph.test.ts:8-10 documents it. This is correct under the current config (isolate: true default) but is fragile if isolate is ever disabled — the comment should be treated as a load-bearing invariant.

tests/server-api.test.ts:63-70 now exercises the real checkDatabaseConnection through the real createPrismaClient with only the facade's PrismaClient symbol replaced. Intentional (the old vi.mock('../src/server.js') re-implemented the function under test) and covered by the new 'factory itself throws' test at line 238, but the coupling to real adapter construction is worth noting.

Coverage thresholds are not numerically enforced today (vitest.config.ts wires no coverage.thresholds; pr.yml:176 job and pr.yml:233 comment are stale). Pre-existing and untouched by Stage A; current figures (87.13/73.07/93.5/87.7) exceed 80/80/70/80 anyway. Correctly flagged as issue #150 for the next sprint.

workflow_dispatch was added to pr.yml but the run URL is promised as post-walkthrough evidence, not yet attached. Acceptable given the stated sequencing, but the evidence should be recorded before merge.
experts.summary: I maintain APPROVED at confidence 8. The eb707f9 delta resolves my T-M (timeout dedup: single PRISMA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS at prisma-factory.ts:5, imported by both helpers) and the db.test.ts unstub minor; the graph.test.ts non-unstub is now backed by concrete empirical evidence (pending setImmediate outliving the last test) rather than assertion, which is stronger than the letter of the ask. The remaining items — shared-DB collision risk (F-M2), helper construction duplication, credential fallback, getDb() DI bypass — are all deliberate Stage A intermediate-state choices with documented Stage B remediation (DD-005), and none block execution as written. The production facade/factory wiring, CI prisma generate additions across six jobs, and the new contract tests (factory-throws guard at server-api.test.ts:238, isClosed teardown/cleanup at test-database.test.ts) are correct and verifiable.

major_concerns: F-M2 residual (conditional, non-blocking): the shared single test DB with fileParallelism: true remains structurally collision-prone until Stage B (per-instance PGlite, DD-005) lands. The interim triage protocol I required now exists verbatim in AGENTS.md (Shared test DB note: isolation rerun -> npx vitest run <file> --no-file-parallelism -> fixture scoping, never weaken assertions), and the two known collision classes are patched (file-unique userIds in tests/batch-import.test.ts; 'Phone-'-scoped cleanup predicate in tests/interview-plan-members-phone.test.ts afterEach). Repeated full-suite runs at eb707f9 are green (116 files / 1261 tests, zero unhandled errors). Remaining condition: Stage B (M3, committed as the immediate next milestone in this sprint) must land on schedule — schedule adherence, not the changeset, is the open risk.

Coverage gate integrity (new, disclosed by author under F-M4): vitest.config.ts wires no coverage.thresholds, so the 'Coverage Check (80/80/70/80)' job (pr.yml:176) and its pr.yml:233 comment do not numerically gate today. Pre-existing (thresholds removed by 22bad13, 2026-07-28), untouched by Stage A, and current figures (87.13/73.07/93.5/87.7) exceed all four axes, so this does not block Stage A — but the AC is not objectively enforced in CI mechanism until enforcement is restored (tracked as issue #150, next sprint in queue).
minor_concerns: workflow_dispatch is added to pr.yml but not yet exercised; the dispatched-run URL is to be recorded as M2/M4 evidence at push, before any merge — acceptable as a scheduled verification step.

Credential fallback 'postgresql://investigator:zhulaoda@localhost:5432/dialog_survey_test' persists in tests/helpers/create-test-prisma.ts:5-9 (pre-existing parity with origin/master test-db.ts:14); confirm removal lands with Stage B PGlite so the helper internals no longer dial a network URL with a bounded 5s timeout when env is unset.

F-M3 residual: Postgres-less runs pay one bounded ~5s doomed connect attempt via getDb() -> createPrismaClient(); rejection caught in the graph.ts fire-and-forget path — accepted as bounded operational cost.

Several suites depend on Vitest 4 awaiting async describe factories (describe(..., async () => await getSharedTestPrisma())); the re-verify-on-upgrade note in AGENTS.md is the right mitigation — carry it into any Vitest bump checklist.
E2E budget inflation watch item retained: waitUntil 'commit' (30s) and vi.waitFor 15s raise per-test ceilings; full-suite wall clock 78.1s remains within budget — continue monitoring.

tests/graph.test.ts keeps a process-lifetime DATABASE_URL stub with a documented, experimentally verified rationale (unstub re-creates an unhandled setImmediate error); valid under default per-file module isolation, but re-check if vitest isolate is ever disabled.
experts.summary: I maintain APPROVED and raise confidence from 8 to 9: every feasibility ask is closed with verifiable evidence — the F-M2 triage protocol is now in AGENTS.md with Stage B (PGlite, DD-005) scheduled as M3, F-M4 numbers are restated with the ≤0.1pp coverage delta attributable to the factory constant refactor, workflow_dispatch is in pr.yml, and the fake-ws and e2e timing fixes remove external network dependencies from CI. The author's disclosure that coverage thresholds are absent from vitest.config.ts is a pre-existing gate-integrity gap (tracked as #150, figures currently pass) and does not block Stage A. Residual risk is concentrated in shared-DB collisions until Stage B lands; my approval is conditional on the M3 schedule holding and #150 restoring numeric enforcement.
